title: 第一卷 第21章 兄弟齐心第一卷 第22章 庞然大物
lines: 寒光闪烁，陈玄只感觉到一股气浪瞬间直奔自己而来。
“小心！”陈岩低吼了一声，他一把将陈玄给推开，而后自己也朝着旁边闪了开去！
而这个刀客，却没有理会陈岩，他这一刀砍空的同时，下一刻，他刀身一横，而后横着一刀，直奔陈玄的腰腹而去。
“小心！”陈岩低喝一声。
陈玄眼疾手快，他凭借着惯性再度后退，躲避开了对方这致命一刀。
但是那刀锋之上，却有着一股气浪散发开来，陈玄只感觉自己的小腹一阵的灼热。
这还是他来到这个世界之后，第一次真正和这个世界的习武者交手。
当初和赵凇动手，赵凇根本就没动真格，甚至都没调动体内的内劲，只凭借着强大的力量，便把他甩出了门外。
此时陈岩顺手抄起了一根棍子，他举着棍子就从后方冲了上来，他一棍直奔刀客的后脑勺而去！
感受着后面的威胁，这刀客也不敢大意，他猛然转身一刀斩出，那棍子刹那之间便被他一刀平切开去。
然而让陈玄诧异的是，他记忆之中从来都是无比温顺的陈岩，此时眼神之中却浮现出了杀机。
棍子被切开的那一刻，他另外一只手在棍子的底端猛然一拍。
那被长刀削尖的棍子，陡然一个前刺！
而这刀客在一刀斩断了棍子的时候，他一脚便踹出，狠狠地踹在了陈岩的小腹之上。
陈岩惨叫一声，口吐鲜血，狠狠地被踹出去好几米远！
但是这名刀客也没想到，陈岩居然有着这一手。
他躲闪不及，那被他一刀削尖的木棍被刹那之间刺在了刀客的身上。
剧烈的疼痛，让得这名刀客，忍不住发出了一声痛苦的嘶吼！
包括陈玄也惊呆了，他这大哥，竟然有着如此的战斗技巧，这是临场的判断，这是经常厮杀的人，才会有的一个判断！
当然，他心惊的同时，身体却没有停靠下来，他在地上抓起了一把沙土。
整个人贴向了刀客！
他一声低喝！
刀客也是个狠人，他腰部吃痛的情况之下，他却猛然转过身来，手中的刀再度横斩。
陈玄直接右手一挥，沙尘瞬间直奔刀客的眼睛而去。
同时他借助着惯性跪地滑动，躲避开着刀客一刀的同时，他整个人也已经来到了刀客的身前。
那一把沙子丢出去，这刀客下意识的闭上了眼睛。
陈玄来到他身前，他清晰的看到了他腰部被那根棍子刺中的地方，已经有着鲜血流淌了出来。
陈玄握拳，狠狠地对着他受伤的地方，一拳便砸了过去！
这一拳，让刀客倒吸了一口凉气！
远处，陈岩砸落在了地上，但是他的眼睛，却死死的盯着陈玄，在看到陈玄这一系列的动作之际，他都愣了一下！
而此时刀客忍着剧痛，又是一刀朝着下方刺了下去。
“小心！”
陈岩一声低吼。
然而下一刻，他却看到陈玄整个身子如同泥鳅一般，从刀客的当下绕到了其后背之上，同时他从后方一跃而起，双手勾住了这刀客的脖子。同时双腿死死的夹住了刀客的腹部！
下一瞬间，陈玄全身发力。
依然是裸绞！
很显然，这刀客没有赵凇那样的身体素质。

The cold light flickered, and Chen Xuan felt a wave of air coming straight towards him instantly.
"Be careful!" Chen Yan growled, he pushed Chen Xuan away, and then he also dodged to the side!
But the swordsman ignored Chen Yan. When he struck the air with his sword, the next moment, he slashed the blade horizontally, and then slashed straight towards Chen Xuan's waist and abdomen.
"Be careful!" Chen Yan shouted.
Chen Xuan had quick eyes and quick hands. He relied on his inertia to retreat again and avoided the opponent's fatal knife.
But there was a wave of air emanating from the blade, and Chen Xuan felt a burning sensation in his lower abdomen.
This is the first time since he came to this world that he has really fought against the martial arts practitioners of this world.
When he first started fighting with Zhao Song, Zhao Song didn't show his true strength at all, and he didn't even mobilize the inner energy in his body. He just relied on his strong strength to throw him out.
At this time, Chen Yan picked up a stick and rushed up from behind with the stick in hand. He hit the swordsman's head straight with the stick!
Feeling the threat from behind, the swordsman did not dare to be careless. He suddenly turned around and slashed out with his sword, and the stick was sliced ​​through in an instant.
However, what surprised Chen Xuan was that Chen Yan, who had always been extremely docile in his memory, now had murderous intent in his eyes.
The moment the stick was cut open, he slapped the bottom of the stick with his other hand.
The stick that was sharpened by a long knife suddenly stabbed forward!
When the swordsman cut off the stick with one stroke, he kicked out and hit Chen Yan hard on the lower abdomen.
Chen Yan screamed, vomited blood, and was kicked several meters away!
But the swordsman didn't expect that Chen Yan actually had this skill.
He couldn't dodge, and the wooden stick sharpened by his sword was stabbed into the swordsman's body in an instant.
"Ah!"
The severe pain caused the swordsman to scream in pain!
Even Chen Xuan was shocked. His eldest brother actually had such fighting skills. This was a judgment on the spot, a judgment only made by people who often fight!
Of course, while he was frightened, his body did not stop. He grabbed a handful of sand on the ground.
The whole person leaned towards the swordsman!
"Hey!"
He shouted lowly!
The swordsman was also a ruthless man. Although his waist was hurting, he suddenly turned around and slashed with the sword in his hand again.
"Phew!"
Chen Xuan waved his right hand, and the sand flew straight into the swordsman's eyes.
At the same time, he used his inertia to slide on his knees, avoiding the swordsman's sword. At the same time, he had already arrived in front of the swordsman.
Throwing out the handful of sand, the swordsman subconsciously closed his eyes.
Chen Xuan came to him, and he could clearly see blood flowing out of the place where he was stabbed by the stick on his waist.
Chen Xuan clenched his fist and punched the injured area with one punch!
"Hiss!"
This punch made the swordsman take a breath!
In the distance, Chen Yan fell to the ground, but his eyes were fixed on Chen Xuan. When he saw Chen Xuan's series of actions, he was stunned for a moment!
At this time, the swordsman endured the severe pain and stabbed downward again.
"Be careful!"
Chen Yan roared.
However, the next moment, he saw Chen Xuan's whole body like a loach, moving around the swordsman's back. At the same time, he jumped up from behind and hooked his hands around the swordsman's neck. At the same time, his legs tightly clamped the swordsman's abdomen!
The next moment, Chen Xuan exerted all his strength.
Still naked hanging!
Obviously, this swordsman does not have the physical fitness of Zhao Song.
